description: Source code implementing crit-bit tree data structure with functions for insertion, lookup, and iteration.

methods.name: cb_node_of
methods.description: Converts a pointer to a cb_node from a void pointer, adjusting for internal encoding.

methods.name: cb_internal_best_match
methods.description: Finds the best matching node in the crit-bit tree without final comparison.

methods.name: cb_insert
methods.description: Inserts a node into the crit-bit tree, returns existing node if duplicate.

methods.name: cb_lookup
methods.description: Looks up a node in the crit-bit tree by key.

methods.name: cb_descend
methods.description: Recursively traverses the tree, applying a callback function.

methods.name: cb_each
methods.description: Iterates over nodes matching a prefix, applying a callback function.
